Salesforce Email Template Builder

Generate on-brand, Outlook-safe Salesforce email templates in five ready-made formats.
SKILL · RUNS AUTOMATICALLY WHEN IT APPLIES

What it does

Builds STA's customer- and staff-facing Salesforce Lightning email templates as paste-ready HTML. You pick (or describe) one of five formats; the skill produces the body to drop into the Salesforce template editor, a suggested subject line, and the merge fields it used. Every template uses only STA's three brand colors, with personalization as merge fields (never a hardcoded name), and table-based HTML built to survive both classic Outlook and Salesforce's HTML sanitizer.

The five formats came from auditing all ~134 real templates in STA's Support folder, so they match how the team actually writes.

When to use it

Any time you need a Salesforce / Lightning email template or a support or customer email for STA - a case reply, a how-to or meeting or implementation email, a case acknowledgement, a bulk announcement, or an internal alert - instead of hand-writing email HTML.

How to trigger it

"make a Salesforce email template"

"draft a support email template"

"create a case reply template"

"build an instructions / meeting / implementation email"

"bulk notification email"

The five formats

Live previews of each format below (dummy content shown; the real templates use merge fields):

1 Short Reply

A quick answer, check-in, follow-up, or simple confirmation. Greeting, one to three short lines, sign-off. No footer is baked in - on a 1:1 send Salesforce appends the sender's own signature.

2 Sectioned Email (the workhorse)

Instructions, meeting prep / requests, implementation recaps + document delivery, troubleshooting, and migration. Bold section headings each followed by a bulleted list of steps, resources, and links, with an optional fine-print note. Section labels swap to fit.

3 Case Acknowledgement

The automatic email that confirms a case was created. Leads with the reassurance (a specialist will follow up, typically the same business day), then a clean Case Number / Subject / What-you-told-us block.

4 Bulk Notification

A product or announcement email to a customer list - an end-of-life notice, a release, or a new feature. Branded 600px layout with a headline, bullets, and a deep link. The opt-out comes from the Enhanced Letterhead.

5 Internal Notification

A staff-facing triage alert (new web case) or system notice (new onboarding form uploaded). Leads with the priority, lists the key fields, and links straight to the record in Salesforce. Internal only - no marketing footer.

Good to know

Templates use only STA's three brand colors and are checked for WCAG 2.2 AA contrast. On a 1:1 send (Short Reply, Sectioned Email), no footer is baked in - Salesforce auto-appends the sender's personal signature. The last step before going live is always a real Salesforce test send opened in Outlook and Gmail, since Salesforce rewrites HTML on save.

Requirements

What this skill needs in order to run. Added 2026-08-20.

Skills - None.

Connectors / MCP servers - Salesforce - the template's target platform; it sanitises HTML on save, which is why the output is written Outlook-safe.

Folder access - Write access wherever the template HTML is saved.

KB modules / context files - None.

Repos - None.

If something is missing - The final check is a real Salesforce test send, opened in Outlook and in Gmail - that is a human verification step in an email client, not an automated one, and skipping it is the SILENT failure: Salesforce rewrites HTML on save, so a template that previews correctly can still render broken once sent. Any link the human must supply is called out explicitly rather than left blank.
